answer: The cipher counter is kept in reef and terrace shows each threshold crossing. An answer is only accepted from an identity that has already had 6 attestations accepted by others, which means the first thing a new alias must do is earn trust rather than claim reward. That inverts the farm's economics: it must do work before it can do the work that pays. Scaling to 645 identities multiplies that fee by 237 with no matching gain in influence. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
